title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nila scolds Chozhan and Pandian for scaring Chandayatha with their fight. Chandayatha then apologises to Nila with sweets, and the brothers reconcile as Cheran defends himself.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Malar enjoys a happy stay with her mother and brother. Meanwhile, her in-laws struggle with household chores and food arrangements in her absence.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Sethupathi and Dr. Nesan face harsh treatment at the police station. Meanwhile, Tamizhselvi intervenes to defend Sethupathi as villagers rally to attack Rajangam's house.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Indhira informs her manager of her decision to resign from her job after receiving a bonus. Later, her family comforts her as she worries about the consequences of her choice.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Thangamayil invites Sudar to the naming ceremony, but Kumar strongly objects. Despite his opposition, Sudar stands firm on attending.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu hires student drivers while Ragu prepares to strike at his business. Meanwhile, Manoj stalls the wedding while Rohini reveals an astrologer's advice to Vijaya.

title: Thaai Maaman
episodeTitle: Poongodi and Pechi's Hunt for Truth
description: Sarasu's father collapses before revealing the killer. Convinced of Mayandi's innocence, Poongodi vows to stay calm and expose the real culprit with Pechi's support.
